title: The release runbook omits DEC-38 deferral of the format-compatibility question
description: DEC-38 (option A) removed the state document version gate and deliberately deferred the format-compatibility question to the first release rather than answering it. ADR 0010 records that deferral and names the arm left aside. The obligation now has no carrier where a release would read it: docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md says of itself that it is where a release recorded obligations live, and it does not mention the format or the compatibility question at all. Measured 2026-09-29 with positive controls in the same invocation: the 71-line runbook returns 0 for format, 0 for compat and 0 for key set, while profileSnapshotVersion returns 3 and DEC-50 returns 2. No open task carries it either, since only the completed WCLI-11, WCLI-40 and WCLI-51 mention key sets. This adds it as a release step in the ADR 0018 shape: an obligation recorded elsewhere and carried by the runbook.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md carries the DEC-38 deferral as a release step: the format-compatibility question is answered at the first release, and the arm left aside (relaxing the reader to tolerate unknown keys) is named with the reason it was left aside.
lore check and lore validate --strict both exit 0 on the branch.
The runbook summary names the added obligation rather than enumerating four of five.

plan: 1. Add the DEC-38 deferral to docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md as a release step, naming the arm left aside and why it was left aside.
2. Update the runbook summary so it names the added obligation rather than four of five.
3. Run lore validate --strict, lore check --strict, the agent-source coverage script and bun run check.
4. Land through a pull request into dev and close WCLI-63 in it.
finalSummary: The release runbook now carries DEC-38 deferral of the format-compatibility question as step 5. WHAT CHANGED: docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md gains a step that answers the question at the first release, deciding whether the state document reader keeps its exact key-set comparison, and it names the arm DEC-38 left aside (relaxing the reader to tolerate unknown keys) with the reason it was left aside, that an unknown field on an authority record would be dropped silently from something that decides access. The gate-results step is renumbered to 6; one Purpose sentence is amended because it claimed every item below was a decision already accepted, and this one is the act of deciding; the summary names the added obligation at 195 characters. docs/log.md carries the WCLI-61 entry lore sync reconciled on the way, the same lag the existing entries show. WHY: the runbook says of itself that it is where a release recorded obligations live, and the deferral had no carrier there. Measured before the change with positive controls in the same invocation, so an empty result could not pass as clean: the 71-line runbook returned 0 for format, 0 for compat and 0 for key set while profileSnapshotVersion returned 3 and DEC-50 returned 2; no open task carried it either, only the completed WCLI-11, WCLI-40 and WCLI-51. VERIFIED: lore validate --strict, lore check --strict, lore agents --check, node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs (23 concepts, 4 profiles, 0 packs truncated) and bun run check (705 pass, 0 fail) all exit 0. Delivered in opum-ai/ward-cli#134; CI run 36613630837 on 45b68a3 covers the deliverable, and the tracker-only closing commit after it is covered by the merge gate. Not promoted: it rides the next batch, per instruction.
